title: AI anxiety sparks tech rout, broad selloff in Asian markets
title_zh: 人工智能焦虑引发科技股溃败和亚洲市场广泛抛售
summary: SINGAPORE, July 28 (Reuters) - Asian markets fell on Tuesday led by chipmakers on unease about the massive funding demands of the AI boom, while a slide in oil prices did relatively little to lift
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 7 月 28 日 - 亚洲市场周二下跌，芯片制造商领跌，原因是对人工智能繁荣的巨大资金需求感到不安，而油价下跌对提振作用相对较小。

title: Anthropic’s Amodei Rejects Open Model Ban But Calls for Testing
title_zh: Anthropic 的 Amodei 拒绝开放模型禁令，但呼吁进行测试
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Silicon Valley leaders, including Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei and Nvidia Corp.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——硅谷领导人，包括 Anthropic PBC 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 和 Nvidia 公司。

title: SK Hynix’s Rebound From $470 Billion Rout Hinges on AI Spending
title_zh: SK 海力士从 4700 亿美元的溃败中反弹取决于人工智能支出
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A $470 billion rout in just a little over a month has flipped SK Hynix Inc.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——在短短一个多月的时间里，SK海力士公司就遭遇了 4700 亿美元的暴跌。

title: Wall Street ends mixed as investors focus on tech earnings
title_zh: 投资者关注科技股盈利，华尔街收盘涨跌互现
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended mixed on Monday, with the Dow gaining half a percent, the S&P 500 virtually flat and the Nasdaq dropping marginally.Investors awaited earnings results from Big Tech companies this week, including Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Apple.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街周一收盘涨跌不一，道指上涨 0.5%，标准普尔 500 指数基本持平，纳斯达克指数小幅下跌。投资者等待本周微软、亚马逊、Meta 和苹果等大型科技公司的财报。

title: Nvidia reportedly in talks to finance OpenAI's massive Ohio data center
title_zh: 据报道 Nvidia 正在洽谈为 OpenAI 俄亥俄州大型数据中心提供资金
summary: Chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA) is reportedly in talks with OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) to help fund a $250 billion backstop, according to the Wall Street Journal, that would guarantee the latter's plans for an AI data center in Ohio.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，芯片制造商 Nvidia (NVDA) 正在与 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 进行谈判，以帮助资助 2500 亿美元的支持资金，这将保证后者在俄亥俄州建立人工智能数据中心的计划。

title: Elon Musk's Tesla, SpaceX shed $1.2T in July, while Apple sprints ahead: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下的特斯拉 (Tesla)、SpaceX 7 月份亏损 1.2 吨，而苹果 (Apple) 则遥遥领先：每日图表
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a look at how market capitalization changed in July for the top US stocks: SpaceX (SPCX), Tesla (TSLA), Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), and Apple (AAPL).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 研究了 7 月份美国顶级股票的市值变化：SpaceX (SPCX)、特斯拉 (TSLA)、Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL) 和苹果 (AAPL)。

title: SpaceX stock plunge sends a big reminder to those who want to get in on or near IPO day
title_zh: SpaceX 股价暴跌给那些想在 IPO 日或临近 IPO 日入场的人敲响了警钟
summary_zh: 给 IPO 粉丝的一个提醒。

title: Why all eyes are on Meta & Amazon earnings this week
title_zh: 为什么本周所有人的目光都集中在 Meta 和亚马逊的财报上
summary: It's a big week for tech earnings, with Amazon (AMZN), Apple (AAPL), Meta (META), and Microsoft (MSFT) all set to report quarterly results.
summary_zh: 对于科技公司来说，这是重要的一周，亚马逊 (AMZN)、苹果 (AAPL)、Meta (META) 和微软 (MSFT) 都将公布季度业绩。

title: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT booms in IPO. Does US memory stand a chance?
title_zh: 中国存储芯片制造商长鑫存储IPO火爆。美国记忆还有机会吗？
summary: China's biggest memory chipmaker, ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), is surging in its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what investors should know about emerging Chinese competition in the tech space.
summary_zh: 中国最大的存储芯片制造商长鑫存储科技（CXMT）在上海证券交易所的首次公开募股（IPO）进展顺利。雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 解释了投资者应该了解中国科技领域新兴竞争的哪些信息。
